# Difinery

> Difinery is a fine jewelry brand. Every piece is handcrafted in NYC with lab-grown diamonds and 100% recycled 14k gold, in yellow, white and rose gold. Prices are in US dollars.

## Shop

- [All jewelry](https://difinery.com/shop/all/yellow-gold/all): every piece, in yellow gold. Swap the metal segment for `white-gold` or `rose-gold`.
- [Rings](https://difinery.com/shop/rings/yellow-gold/all)
- [Necklaces and pendants](https://difinery.com/shop/necklaces/yellow-gold/all)
- [Earrings](https://difinery.com/shop/earrings/yellow-gold/all)
- [Bracelets](https://difinery.com/shop/bracelets/yellow-gold/all)
- [Engagement rings](https://difinery.com/bridal/engagement-rings)
- [Wedding bands](https://difinery.com/bridal/wedding-bands)
- [Promise rings](https://difinery.com/bridal/promise-rings)
- [Gift card](https://difinery.com/shop/gift-card)

## How buying works

- Listing URLs follow `/shop/<category>/<metal>/<style>`. Product pages live at `/shop/<category>/product/<handle>`. Add `?gold=yellow`, `?gold=white` or `?gold=rose` to open a product in that metal.
- Each product page includes its name, price, options (metal, size, carat weight, shape), and Product / Offer structured data (JSON-LD).
- Choose every option, then press "Add to Cart" (mobile) or "Review & Add to Cart" (desktop). On the gift card page the button reads "Go to Cart"; it adds the card and opens the cart. The cart opens from the bag icon in the header. Checkout runs on Shopify.
- Engraving and a hand-lettered gift box are optional add-ons on the product page.
- Orders are fulfilled within 7 business days. Special requests can add 2–3 business days.
